segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin split sharply: several report rashes, burning, or increased reactivity to other products, while others say it works with no irritation and even call it 'sensitive skin friendly.'
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports it left skin refreshed without sinking into pores, and another with oily/dry combination skin says it balanced both.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report mixed hydration results, from feeling tight and clay-mask-like or causing dry hands, to giving life to dry skin and fixing dryness/itchiness after showering.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (including acne-prone combination) skin report smoother texture and clearer, refreshed-feeling skin.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the serum as hydrating, nourishing, and smoothing; however, others report it feels drying, tight like a clay mask, or dries out hands, and one notes it is drying enough to require sunscreen.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers describe rashes or reactive, red, irritated skin after repeated use, with one calling it a straightforward allergic reaction rather than a product flaw.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the product made her skin more reactive to other products she previously tolerated, describing burning with her regular routine after starting the serum.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers who mention dark spots or hyperpigmentation report fading or evening of tone, including one describing 60% lightening of 20+ year old hyperpigmentation, though one reviewer explicitly says it did not brighten her skin.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report mixed effects on breakouts and acne scarring: some describe fading acne scars and no new breakouts, while others describe the worst breakout of their life or a bad rash after just a few uses.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the serum feels refreshing without clogging pores, and another notes it is lightweight and doesn't weigh skin down with oils.

aspects.libelle: Irritation or rash with repeated use

Everything isn't for everyone. I too have really sensitive skin and this stuff works like a charm. If you're breaking out after use, that's because you didn't follow the instructions. Always spot test and wait 48-72 hours for a reaction. You can even try using it in your routine several times a week instead of daily because this stuff actually works and it's cheaper than a cup of coffee. I've had deep deep hyperpigmentation in the corners of my mouth for 20+ years and it's lightened it up 60% or so in less than a year. I actually like looking in a mirror now and don't hate taking selfies or wearing lipstick now. Besides if it burns your skin, that's a YOU problem because YOUR allergic, it's not a failing of the product and shouldn't be used as a scare-tatic to keep people away from a product that actually does work! SPOT TEST!
